locators.statement_paraphrase: Gluing two smooth compact manifold triads along a specified boundary diffeomorphism admits a compatible smooth structure, unique up to a diffeomorphism fixing the two external boundaries and the gluing interface.
locators.application: Supports smooth composition with the existing boundary identifications. It is a gluing-uniqueness result; the full attaching maps are supplied by the manuscript.

locators.supporting_definition: Definition3.9, printedp28 (full PDFp34), defines the characteristic embedding on the entire sphere times an open normal disk.
locators.statement_paraphrase: An elementary cobordism with characteristic embedding phi_L is diffeomorphic, as a triad, to the explicit model omega(V,phi_L).
locators.application: Supports classification of each single-critical-point piece by its full characteristic embedding. The manuscript supplies the normal coordinates of its handle embeddings in E.H3–E.H11 and constructs the relative comparisons.

locators.supporting_argument: The vector-field extension and cutoff construction on printedpp62–63 (full PDFpp68–69) was also read. The book states5.8 and points to other references for a full proof.
locators.statement_paraphrase: A smooth isotopy of the inclusion of a compact submanifold into a smooth boundaryless ambient manifold extends to an ambient isotopy of the identity, fixed outside a compact set.
locators.application: Theorem5.8 gives ambient extension in the stated scope. The manuscript’s subsequent velocity-field, collar and cutoff paragraph provides its relative framed application to full attaching domains and the protected marked boundary. That relative clause is not attributed as a literal clause of5.8.
